why: I keep her: the golden ram's dry twig that greens when it is happy already shows renewal under a kind hand.

veto.quote: magic that is cute but has no power behind it
veto.why: An icon is decoration alone, so the pet would be cute with no work behind it.

style: Gold and herb green against a night-dark ground, so every pet reads as one family.
making: My worry is drift: nineteen separate drawings may lose the gold and herb green, so check each pet against the style sheet.
